// Reference code (not production): generated from Figma "Brownfield Design" > Library - Music by tools/screen_code.py.
// DS names only (Music App Android design system); colors follow the Light / Dark theme.

import androidx.compose.foundation.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.*

@Composable
fun LibraryMusicScreen(navigate: (String) -> Unit) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
    ) {
        StatusBar(time = "5:00", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        // Search Section
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing12),
        ) {
            SearchBar(
                placeholder = "Search in your library",
                iconSearch = AppIcons.Search,
                iconMic = AppIcons.Mic,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
        }
        // Library Tabs
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            // Tabs Row
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
                PrimaryTabs(
                    firstTab = TabItem(selected = true, label = "MUSIC"),
                    secondTab = TabItem(label = "PODCASTS"),
                    onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("library-music"); 1 -> navigate("library-podcasts") } },
                )
                IconButton(icon = AppIcons.Settings)
                IconButton(icon = AppIcons.Help)
            }
            Divider(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        }
        // Filter Chips
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            FilterChip(selected = true, label = "Playlists")
            FilterChip(label = "Albums")
            FilterChip(label = "Artists")
        }
        // Shortcut Tiles
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            LibraryShortcutTile(
                label = "Likes",
                icon = AppIcons.Favorite,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            LibraryShortcutTile(
                color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Cyan,
                label = "Downloads",
                icon = AppIcons.CloudDownload,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            LibraryShortcutTile(
                color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Magenta,
                label = "Created for you",
                icon = AppIcons.Album,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            LibraryShortcutTile(
                color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Yellow,
                label = "Your uploads",
                icon = AppIcons.Upload,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
        }
        // Playlists Header
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            ListHeader(
                title = "Playlists",
                showAction = true,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
        }
        // Playlists
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1367_10_391),
                title = "Arabic Music Mix",
                subtitle = "469 songs · By you",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1385_10_391),
                title = "Music Mix",
                subtitle = "541 songs · By you",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1396_10_391),
                title = "Farah",
                subtitle = "46 songs · by Nourhan Bahey",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1407_10_391),
                title = "Amr diab",
                subtitle = "101 songs · By you",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1418_10_391),
                title = "Fayrouz",
                subtitle = "28 songs · By you",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1429_10_391),
                title = "Massar Egbari - Maba'etsh Aktar",
                subtitle = "10 songs · By you",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1440_10_391),
                title = "نجوم تغنى كوكب الشرق",
                subtitle = "36 songs",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PlaylistListItem(
                showMore = true,
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1451_10_391),
                title = "Music & OST",
                subtitle = "105 songs · By you",
                onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
        }
        BottomNavigation(
            firstItem = NavigationItem(label = "Explore", icon = AppIcons.Explore),
            secondItem = NavigationItem(label = "Search", icon = AppIcons.Search),
            thirdItem = NavigationItem(label = "Connect", icon = AppIcons.Groups),
            fourthItem = NavigationItem(
                selected = true,
                label = "Your Library",
                icon = AppIcons.LibraryMusic,
            ),
            onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("explore-viewport"); 1 -> navigate("search-discover-viewport"); 3 -> navigate("library-music") } },
        )
        MiniPlayer(
            image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1180_10_451),
            title = "لو كنت غالى",
            subtitle = "مصطفى قمر",
            onOpen = { navigate("now-playing") },
        )
    }
}
